using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

long long memo[105][25][11];
char pattern[105];
int pattern_len;

long long solve(int pos, int remainder, int value) {
    if (pos == pattern_len) {
        return remainder == 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (memo[pos][remainder][value] != -1) {
        return memo[pos][remainder][value];
    }
    long long count = 0;
    if (pattern[pos] == '_') {
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
            if (pos == 0 && digit == 0) continue;
            int newRem = (remainder * 10 + digit) % 25;
            count += solve(pos + 1, newRem, value);
        }
    } else if (pattern[pos] == 'X') {
        if (value != 10) {
            count += solve(pos + 1, (remainder * 10 + value) % 25, value);
        } else {
            for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
                if (pos == 0 && digit == 0) continue;
                int newRem = (remainder * 10 + digit) % 25;
                count += solve(pos + 1, newRem, digit);
            }
        }
    } else {
        int digit = pattern[pos] - '0';
        count += solve(pos + 1, (remainder * 10 + digit) % 25, value);
    }
    return memo[pos][remainder][value] = count;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int testCaseCount = 1;
    while (testCaseCount-- > 0) {

                continue;
            }

        cout << solve(0, 0, 10) << "\n";
    }

}
